scenario: A sponsor company's regulatory affairs agent pipeline drafts the Reference Safety Information (RSI) section of an Investigator's Brochure (IB) for an ongoing phase-2 clinical trial. The pipeline first uses clinical-data-cleaner to extract and standardize the AE frequency and severity data from the clinical safety database export, then uses ub2-csv-data-analyzer to aggregate and normalize the AE frequency table across treatment arms, and finally uses health-report to produce the updated RSI section narrative that investigators use for informed consent and AE causality assessments.
info_flow: clinical-data-cleaner standardizes and grades the raw AE SDTM dataset → ub2-csv-data-analyzer aggregates per-AE frequency and severity counts into summary statistics → health-report produces the RSI narrative section describing AE frequency and severity language for the IB.
